notes.title: Game on discount as part of Spy Video Game Rendezvous festival
notes.content:
Going on now - the first-ever Steam festival (and accompanying Direct) for spy video games, the [b]Spy Video Game Rendezvous[/b], includes all the games in the [b]There's Always a Madman[/b] series.
[list]
[*] Spy Video Game Rendezvous Direct: [url=https://youtu.be/OmzdWLCbzpE]https://youtu.be/OmzdWLCbzpE[/url]
[*] Spy Video Game Rendezvous Festival: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45263338/sale/SpyVideoGameRendezvous]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45263338/sale/SpyVideoGameRendezvous[/url]
[/list]
Each of the two released games in the [b]There's Always a Madman[/b] series are on discount for the festival:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url]
[/list]
[b]Also announced as part of the festival:[/b] the third entry in the series, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url], will be releasing July 7th 2025[b][/b].  That's right - Agent 707 returns on 7/7, and there's a [b]free demo for the game you can play right now[/b] ahead of the June Steam Next Fest.

As you can tell, there's no better time to see if you have the secret agent skills necessary to save the world with two games on discount and another right around the corner (with a free demo of the third game that you can play now).  [b]Because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got![/b]

notes.title: Play the demo. Review the demo
notes.content:
The interactive spy novel [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/b][/i] now has a free demo that you can write a review for.  You can play the demo, then leave a review right here on the newly launched demo store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo[/url]

[h2]About the Game and Demo[/h2]
[i][b]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/b][/i] is a single-player spy thriller interactive novel.  With a silver-loving madman bent on destroying the Golden Gate Bridge, it falls to you as secret agent Virginia West to stop him and save this iconic landmark.  When this much is at stake, [b]don’t do your best, agent … do your worst![/b]

The free demo provides four of the eleven chapters from the full game, ahead of the game's launch in Q4 2024.

[h2]Where to Find More from "There's Always a Madman"[/h2]

[b]Wishlist the full game[/b] and [b]play the free demo[/b] for [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/b][/i] right now right here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo[/url]

The store page of the full game is here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst[/url]

Don't forget to leave a review for the demo, now that it's possible to do so for select demos on Steam!

And if the demo leaves you in the mood to play more, then I have good news: the first game in the series [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] focusing on secret agent Franklin Benjamin is available for purchase on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight[/url]
